def _components(grid, background):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            rs = [p[0] for p in cells]
            cs = [p[1] for p in cells]
            result.append({'color': color, 'cells': cells,
                           'r0': min(rs), 'r1': max(rs),
                           'c0': min(cs), 'c1': max(cs)})
    return result


def _corner_frame(obj):
    cells = obj['cells']
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = obj['r0'], obj['r1'], obj['c0'], obj['c1']
    if r0 == r1 or c0 == c1:
        return False
    horizontal = [r for r in (r0, r1)
                  if all((r, c) in cells for c in range(c0, c1 + 1))]
    vertical = [c for c in (c0, c1)
                if all((r, c) in cells for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))]
    for r in horizontal:
        for c in vertical:
            allowed = ({(r, x) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)} |
                       {(y, c) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)})
            if cells <= allowed and (r, c) in cells:
                return True
    return False


def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects = _components(grid, background)
    for frame in objects:
        if not _corner_frame(frame):

        inside = [obj for obj in objects if obj is not frame and
                  frame['r0'] <= obj['r0'] and obj['r1'] <= frame['r1'] and
                  frame['c0'] <= obj['c0'] and obj['c1'] <= frame['c1']]
        for sample in inside:
